site.description: Read-only pilot import for generator/monitor telemetry.

pilot.label: Generator pilot (read-only)
pilot.notes: Fill sensor mappings and provenance. Validate units/scaling/IDs against source. CSV replay mappings must use schema-supported kind/unit enums.

connections.name: On-site read-only gateway
connections.notes: Gateway reads monitor (Modbus/OPC UA/MQTT/API) and serves /health,/catalog,/samples/latest

instructions: CSV replay path: sourceTag must match the sensor_tag column in telemetry CSV. sensorId is canonical in MINE OS.
Schema limits (site.config): kind = level|flow|pressure|vibration|power|temperature; unit = m|m3/h|kPa|mm/s|kW|degC; provenance = measured|estimated|synthetic.

Signals not representable by these enums/units (e.g. V, A, Hz, pf, %, state) are best integrated via the simple HTTP gateway / Quick Connect (gateway-simple.template.json + samples.template.json) rather than CSV replay mapping.
Set staleness/sample periods, accuracy, scale, and provenance to match the source. Validate units/scaling/IDs before use.
